rules.accepted_credit_types: CME required to hold current NCCPA certification; pharmacology CE through programs approved by the Board or a person it authorizes
rules.alternatives: No separate state hour count: the PA certifies that NCCPA certification is maintained (incl. periodic recertification exams) and that the CME needed for current NCCPA certification is complete.
rules.audit_note: The Board may require a random sample of PAs to document NCCPA certification and CME; false certification can bring discipline and a civil penalty up to $5,000.

topics.who: PAs with physician-delegated prescriptive authority: at least 12 hours of pharmacology every two years, in addition to the NCCPA CME

rules.notes: License valid two years from issuance; renewal online up to 180 days before expiration. Prescribers of opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines must also certify access to the OARRS drug database. Pro rata pharmacology reduction for illness or absence from the country.
